normal_R_window.scope: Discrete R-clock bracket inside original autonomous start/end and Observer last runtime mono cap; not exact Observer start/end. Partial failed phases remain partial; whole actual errors/faults retained independently.

actual_source_identity.scope: Recorded actual launch-ready path/hash plus its explicit source fields; no planned-AAE substitution, hash recomputation or source equivalence inference

explicit_reviewed_case_verdict.scope: No process/qualification PASS inferred by this exporter

observed_process_and_raw_fields.gateway_exit_field_semantics: network-gateway-exit.native_exit is ROS Gateway process, nativeleaf independently0

controller_final.global_progress_activation_basis: First same-session status with any actual R Guard armed; receipt monotonic, not Goal/Policy or bootstrap token
controller_final.achieved_rtf_scope: First physical token issue through latest successful actual physics ACK; not a rate guarantee

case_outcome.scope: Preserve original raw success fields independently from process verdict; metrics/empty ownership do not override controller nonzero

cohort: Conditional normal R-consumed health/mask native IDs, not all native ingress, not a loss denominator
semantics: admission_ns is scheduled native admission, not ingress event time or source_stamp_ns
Send accept is socket-buffer acceptance including 36B headers; not PHY transmit or airtime
Native sim service includes application/TCP queueing, protocol and Wi-Fi retries; no RF-only attribution
Boundary counts compare native monotonic event timestamps with normal R consumption bracket; prior/late events retained
No stages are added together; complete matched messages only; duplicate IDs excluded explicitly
Nearest-rank p95/p99; arithmetic median; negative differences retained
UNMEASURED: Per-message CPU and native Run/STEP wall/CPU: STEP boundaries are stderr, not this ledger
PHY airtime and isolated TCP/Wi-Fi/CPU contributions
